name: Gloom Lizard
description: The gloom lizard is a large lizard known for its unique diet of chitin and bones, which fuels the bioluminescent glow emanating from its body. It is known for it's powerful tongue and extremely hot internal body temperature.

actions.name: Tongue Strike
actions.description: The gloom lizard lashes out with their tongue at a creature within 3 units dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Tongue Grapple
actions.description: After hitting a medium or smaller creature with Tongue Strike action, that target must make an athletics or acrobatic check of 8 or higher or become grappled by the tongue. The gloom lizard cannot use it's Tongue Strike action while grappling a creature in this way.

actions.name: Tongue Pull
actions.description: If the gloom lizard has a small or tiny creature grappled with its tongue, it immediately pulls it into its mouth, giving the creature the engulfed condition and subjecting it to the Volatile Digestion trait. The affected creature must use an action to make an acrobatics or athletics check of 8 or higher to free themselves, moving to free space adjacent to the gloom lizard.

actions.name: Vent
actions.description: When an adjacent creature strikes the gloom lizard with a melee attack, the gloom lizard discharges its Gloomglow in self defense, dealing 1d8 fire damage to all adjacent creatures for each unit of Gloomglow. This ends the effect of the Gloomglow trait.

traits.name: Gloomglow
traits.description: The gloom lizard is a scavenger, often feeding on the bones and chitin of decaying creatures. When they consume the medium or smaller corpse of a creature, the gloom lizard gives off a soft light within a radius equal to the level of the creature consumed, with a minimum of 1 unit, until the start of the next full rest. The gloom lizard must consume the entire corpse for this to take effect.

traits.name: Volatile Digestion
traits.description: Any creature that starts it turn inside the mouth of the gloom lizard takes 1d8 Fire Damage at the start of their turn. This damage is increased by an amount equal to the radius of the current Gloomglow trait.
